title: Score Note Payload
description: Score notes, one row per note. Shared by all symbolic datasets; only midi and tpc are required.

tpc.description: Tonal pitch classes as positions on the line of fifths with C = 0 (G = 1, F = -1, C# = 7, Bb = -2).

name.description: Note names with octave in scientific pitch notation, e.g. 'C#4'.

octave.description: Octave numbers in scientific pitch notation (C4 is middle C).

mc.description: Measure counts: 1-based index of the measure unit in the encoded score (ms3 'mc').

mn.description: Measure numbers as printed in the score (ms3 'mn'; 0 for an anacrusis).

measure.description: Measure numbers in the source dataset's own convention, for datasets that distinguish neither mc nor mn (e.g. BPS-FH).

tied.description: Tie status: 1 = a tie starts here, 0 = tied from and to another note, -1 = a tie ends here; null = not tied.

gracenote.description: Grace note type (e.g. 'acciaccatura', 'appoggiatura', 'grace16'); null for regular notes.

nominal_duration.description: Notated durations as fractions of a whole note before dots and tuplets are applied (e.g. [1, 4] for a quarter note).

scalar.description: Factors that dots and tuplets apply to nominal_duration (e.g. [3, 2] for a dotted note, [2, 3] inside a triplet).

chord_id.description: Identifier of the chord (stem) the note belongs to, unique within the piece.

tremolo.description: Tremolo specification as encoded by the source (e.g. '1/2_r16_0'); null when absent.

volta.description: Volta (ending) number of the measure the note belongs to; null outside voltas.

tuning.description: Tuning offset in cents; null when not specified.

anchor.description: Identifier of the note in its source document, e.g. a match-file anchor such as 'n238'.
